scope: extracted MPI overlap expressions only; not impact-parameter sampling or complete MPI parity

extracted_sources.fortran:
PROGRAM PROBE
      IMPLICIT NONE
      DOUBLE PRECISION PARP(200),PARU(200),B,OV
      DOUBLE PRECISION P83A,P83B,P83C,CQ2I,CQ2R
      PARU(2)=2D0*ACOS(-1D0)
   10 READ(*,*,END=20) PARP(83),PARP(84),B
        P83A=(1D0-PARP(83))**2
        P83B=2D0*PARP(83)*(1D0-PARP(83))
        P83C=PARP(83)**2
        CQ2I=1D0/PARP(84)**2
        CQ2R=2D0/(1D0+PARP(84)**2)
            OV=(P83A*EXP(-MIN(50D0,B**2))+
     &      P83B*CQ2R*EXP(-MIN(50D0,B**2*CQ2R))+
     &      P83C*CQ2I*EXP(-MIN(50D0,B**2*CQ2I)))/PARU(2)
      WRITE(*,'(ES25.17)') OV
      GOTO 10
   20 END
